description: Fetch a GitHub topic's popular repositories from https://github.com/topics/<topic> (e.g. /topics/rust). Returns the topic description and the featured repo cards with full_name, description, language, and star count. Discover topics with: websculpt github list-topics. Reads the rendered topic page; no login required.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Topic slug, i.e. the last path segment of https://github.com/topics/<topic>. Examples: rust, machine-learning. Discover available topics with: websculpt github list-topics.（话题 slug，即 /topics/<topic> 末段路径，如 rust、machine-learning；可用 websculpt github list-topics 查看。）

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum repositories to return (1-100, default 20). The topic page shows a fixed list of up to 20 featured repositories; limit only truncates it.（条数上限；话题页固定展示最多 20 个热门仓库，limit 只做截断。）
